newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi judge to rule on tobacco trial date.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi judge to rule on tobacco trial date.

text.p: A Mississippi judge was expected to rule on Thursday on whether to delay the state's landmark lawsuit against the U.S. tobacco industry until late September.

After a three-hour hearing on Wednesday, Jackson County Chancery Judge William Myers told attorneys for both the state and cigarette makers he would "have some rulings" the next day on whether to discard the current June 2 starting date and other issues.

The judge also said he would consider a request from state Attorney General Mike Moore, who asked him to review about 20 Liggett Group documents for possible use at evidence in the suit, which seeks to recoup state health-care funds spent to treat smokers.
